title: Guard HomeCubit DateTime.parse with FormatException handling
objective: Prevent malformed meetingDateTime strings from crashing HomeCubit sorting/filtering by wrapping DateTime.parse in safe parsing logic.
acceptance_criteria: HomeCubit no longer calls DateTime.parse without FormatException handling
Malformed or null meetingDateTime values are handled with a null/sentinel fallback instead of throwing
No generated .g.dart DateTime.parse calls are modified manually
flutter analyze for HomeCubit reports no new errors
